L2-0187.note: Adv comparative. Keeping the canonical gloss on the L2 word; L3 更加 currently ships the identical "even more" and is the one that should move (e.g. "all the more").

L2-0188.note: Plain noun; CEDICT classifier tail dropped.

L2-0194.note: N. Kept the second CEDICT clause that the clause-1 truncation dropped.

L2-0197.note: V/Adv. Dropped the (coll.) "really" sense. Verb-form primary keeps it distinct from L3 足够 "enough".

L2-0198.note: N. "narrative" is register-wrong for HSK 2; 故事 is simply a story.

L2-0199.note: Adv. "on purpose" is the everyday reading.

L2-0200.note: N. Differentiated from 客人 "guest" at the same level.

L2-0201.note: Dropped the film-industry sense. "a device" keeps it clear of 关 "to close".

L2-0202.note: V. Led with "to be concerned about" because L4 在乎 already ships "to care about".

L2-0203.note: N. Held apart from 看法 (personal view) and 意见 (opinion), both L2.

L2-0205.note: N. Official POS is N, so the noun sense leads and CEDICT sense 1 "to advertise" is not used.

L2-0207.note: V. Dropped "to manage" — the 过来 = cope sense is not an HSK 2 reading.

L2-0209.note: Official POS here is V only; "the past" belongs to the L3 N row of 过去, which currently ships a byte-identical gloss. Verb-only here breaks that cross-level duplicate.

L2-0210.note: Aux particle. Function in plain words instead of "experienced action marker".

L2-0212.note: Avoided "coast"/"shore" so it does not collide with 岸 (L5), which should be glossed shore/coast.

L2-0213.note: V. Not "to shout" — that is 叫 at L1.

L2-0214.note: Official POS is Adv; L1 好 ships the Adj "good". This row is the intensifier (好大, 好久) plus the pre-verb "easy to" (好写).

L2-0215.note: N. Led with "advantage" so it does not duplicate 优点 (L3) "merit, benefit".

L2-0218.note: Dropped "healthy person" and the sardonic people-pleaser sense.

L2-0220.note: V/Adv, verb sense first per official POS.

L2-0222.note: N. Dropped the bound-form Yellow River / Milky Way / rice-noodle senses.

L2-0228.note: N. 后来 narrates past time only, which is the distinction from 以后 and 然后 at the same level.

L2-0232.note: Official POS is V and 花 N "flower" is the L1 row, so dropping "flower" also clears a cross-level duplicate. Named the objects so it does not collide with L5 支出.

meanings: to change one thing for another
L2-0240.note: V. Cannot be "to exchange" (L4 交换) or bare "to change" (L2 变 / L3 变化), so the primary spells out the swap.

L2-0243.note: M. Kept as shipped — distinct from 次 "measure word: times" at L1.

meanings: to return to one's home country

L2-0245.note: Official POS is N; the "can / know how to" senses are the L1 会 V row. Worded to stay clear of L3 会议 "meeting". Fixes the POS mismatch and the cross-level duplicate from the loop-1 verdict.

L2-0246.note: V/N. "to exercise"/"shaky" were minor CEDICT senses; the event sense is what HSK 2 uses (参加活动).

L2-0247.note: Conj. 或 is the written monosyllable; 或者 L2-0248 owns the spoken "or".

L2-0249.note: N. L4 机遇 and L5 时机 both ship "opportunity"; "a chance" is the everyday HSK 2 reading (有机会).

L2-0250.note: N. Dropped the (slang) prostitute sense and the archaic "fowl" lead.

L2-0251.note: N. Bare "level" is taken by L5 平坦 and bare "grade" by L2 年级.

L2-0252.note: Adj. Both HSK 2 readings (你别急 / 急事). Bare "urgent" is already on L3 紧急 and L4 迫切.

L2-0256.note: The encouragement sense is the one every HSK 2 learner meets; CEDICT tags it (fig.) but there is nothing figurative about 加油! as an interjection. Refuelling kept second.

meanings: suffix for an expert in a field
L2-0257.note: Suffix row (画家, 科学家). The noun "home/family" is the L1 家 row.

L2-0259.note: N. The school-parent sense is the HSK 2 usage; "patriarch" is register-wrong.

L2-0260.note: Adj; the jiǎ "to borrow / if" senses belong to other readings.

L2-0263.note: Resultative with a human object. Not "to meet" (L1 见面), "to see" (L1 看见) or "to catch sight of" (L1 看到).

L2-0265.note: M. Removed the internal comma from the shipped gloss, which the browse row joins on ", " and made unparseable.

L2-0267.note: V. 说 "to say", 告诉 "to tell" and 谈 "to speak" are taken; 讲 takes a topic (讲故事, 讲课).

L2-0268.note: Differentiated from 讲 "to speak" and 演讲 (L4) "to give a lecture".

L2-0269.note: V. 交作业/交钱 are the HSK 2 uses; the friends sense is carried by 交朋友.

L2-0270.note: Bare "to give" collides with 给; 交给 always names a recipient.

L2-0272.note: N. CEDICT sense 1 "to be connected" is not the HSK 2 noun.

L2-0273.note: M/N, measure-word sense first. Not "ten cents" — that is 毛 at L1; naming the fraction keeps the two apart and is the accurate written unit.

L2-0274.note: N; the (fig.) marker is dropped but the viewpoint sense is real.

L2-0276.note: N. "leg" in CEDICT is the leg of an animal or object, not a human leg (腿).

L2-0281.note: V/N; the noun sense is worth carrying at this level.

L2-0282.note: V. The two HSK 2 uses, spelled out so the primary does not collide with 答应/答 "to answer".

L2-0286.note: Adv/V. Plain-words primary; "to catch and hold on" is not the HSK 2 sense.

L2-0287.note: N. Bare "street" duplicates 马路 at L1; 街 is the walkable town street.

L2-0288.note: N/M; 一节课 is the HSK 2 use. Festival is 节日.

L2-0292.note: V. 借 genuinely carries both directions at this level.

L2-0293.note: M. Kept the plain weight first; "catty" alone is opaque to a beginner.

L2-0296.note: V. Both readings; the primary avoids L5 执行 "to carry out".

L2-0298.note: Adv. 常常 (L1) already ships "frequently"; 经常 carries the habitual-regularity nuance, so lead with "regularly".

L2-0301.note: N. 酒 is the generic word for alcoholic drink; leading with "wine" mis-teaches it and clashes with 白酒/啤酒.

L2-0303.note: Adv. Held apart from 快要 below: 就要 can take an explicit time word.

L2-0304.note: V. Not "to lift" — that is 抬 (L5).

L2-0309.note: N. The shipped primary "slow" was a (computing)(coll.) CEDICT sense; 卡 at HSK 2 is the card (银行卡).

L2-0310.note: Pairs with 关机. "to start an engine" is the wrong image for a phone or computer.

L2-0311.note: Adj/V. Kept apart from 高兴 "happy" (L1), 快乐 "joyful" (L2) and 痛快 "delighted" (L4); the mock-someone sense dropped.

L2-0313.note: N. Separated from 观点 "point of view" and 意见 "opinion", both L2, without leaning on an article.

L2-0315.note: V. The vulgar sense and the opera-costume sense are both excluded.

L2-0316.note: N. Taxonomy/legal senses dropped; the two live readings are 文科/理科 and 内科-type departments.

L2-0322.note: Aux. Avoids "can", which belongs to 能 and 会 at L1.

L2-0323.note: M; the kè "to subdue" senses are a different word.

L2-0324.note: M; the L5 刻 V row carries "to carve".

L2-0330.note: Correct as shipped; no usable CEDICT entry.

L2-0331.note: Adj. 高兴 (L1) already owns "happy" as its primary, so 快乐 leads with "joyful" and keeps "happy" second — the two are genuine near-synonyms.

L2-0332.note: Adv; held apart from 就要 "will soon".

L2-0339.note: Adv/Prefix merge. The Adj "old" is the L1 老 row, and bare "always" is on L1 常 and L3 总是.

L2-0341.note: N. "elderly" is adjectival and 老人 (L1) already means an old person.

L2-0344.note: V/Prep. The departure sense belongs to 离开; 离 at HSK 2 states distance (离这儿很近).

L2-0347.note: N. 里边 (L1), 里面 (L3) and 中/内/以内/之内 have "inside" and "within" between them; 里头 is the same idea, so the gloss names the container instead.

L2-0349.note: V. 比如 at the same level already ships "for example", and 例如 introduces a list.

L2-0352.note: V. Not bare "to practice" (L2 练习) and not "to train"/"to drill" (L3 训练); the literary white-silk sense dropped.

L2-0355.note: Adj. The (Tw)(slang) scanty-clothing sense and the (coll.) butt-out sense are excluded.
